direction: Probe one bounded savings coefficient change.
hypothesis: A small change in route continuation preference may improve mean distance.

operations.mechanism: Retain the farthest start and score sign. Adjust the coefficient using its existing feasible-demand pressure, without a new global matrix helper such as ix_.
